Messages.Author: Doug Le
Messages.Body:
1) Can a master card be blocked?

2) There are some master cards that has a clan symbol on them.  What do they
   mean?

3) Can a vampire get 2 titles, like a primogen who gets to become Justicar?
   Does he gets 4 votes?

4) Do you tap a vampire to give him/her an equipment?

5) Can you draw a card after you play one during combat?

6) CRUSHER, a Brujah vampire, has the ability to use one blood to dodge.  Is
   this dodge an extra strike, or his only strike.

Messages.Author: Vano Chu
Messages.Body:
In article <34gi05$vf@news.cs.tulane.edu>, Doug Le <le@cs.tulane.edu> wrote:
>1) Can a master card be blocked?
No.  Only minion actions can be blocked.  Most of the time, you can't do 
anything about master actions, but some master cards can be eliminated 
later (e.g. locations can be burned using "Arson" which is a minion 
action or "Unnatural Disaster" which is another master card).

>2) There are some master cards that has a clan symbol on them.  What do they
>   mean?
Means you can only play it if you have a vampire of the appropriate clan 
_ready_ (not uncontrolled and not in torpor - it's OK if he's ready but 
tapped).

>3) Can a vampire get 2 titles, like a primogen who gets to become Justicar?
>   Does he gets 4 votes?
Er, I've seen some debate about this one.  You'll need to ask Tom Wylie.

>4) Do you tap a vampire to give him/her an equipment?
Yes.  Think of it this way: you're not "giving" him/her equipment, he/she 
is going to "get" it from some place under your control (so it counts as 
an action and the vamp is tapped).

>5) Can you draw a card after you play one during combat?
Yes. Unless the card says "DO NOT REPLACE UNTIL AFTER COMBAT," you 
immediately draw another to take its place.

>6) CRUSHER, a Brujah vampire, has the ability to use one blood to dodge.  Is
>   this dodge an extra strike, or his only strike.
My gut feeling on this is that it's his _only_ strike.  The purpose of 
his special ability is to give him the ability to dodge even though you 
don't have a "dodge" card to use on him.  Crusher would be kind of handy 
as a blocker since it would be tough to hurt him badly (until he runs out 
of blood!).

Hope that cleared things up (83%, anyway) for you...
